projects.name: STABLE
projects.subtitle: Improving attribute binding with visual evidence
projects.role: First author · Method design · Implementation & experiments · Writing
projects.summary: I proposed a method that uses internal visual evidence to assess attribute–object associations and steer inference in a single forward pass per caption, without updating model weights.
projects.problem: MLLMs could recognize objects and attributes separately yet associate them incorrectly. I investigated why internal visual evidence supporting the correct answer was not reflected in the final prediction.
contributions: Analyzed image attention and hidden states across layers to identify where visual evidence emerges and where binding relations become distinguishable. I removed shared attention components and estimated visual associations with bidirectional relative correspondence scores (mcBC).

Used agreement between syntactic and visual associations as pseudo-labels to estimate a steering direction without ground-truth labels. After this calibration, steering is applied at later layers only to captions where all bindings agree, requiring one forward pass per caption, no weight updates, and no auxiliary vision or reasoning models.

Implemented model-specific adapters and benchmark evaluation pipelines for Qwen2-VL-7B and LLaVA-1.5-7B. I evaluated on ARO, ColorSwap, SugarCrepe, and Winoground, ran ablations, and kept calibration and evaluation data separate.
projects.outcome: The paper reports LLaVA-1.5-7B ColorSwap Group accuracy of 73.00%, up from VQAScore’s 67.33% (+5.67 percentage points). On 100 ARO samples with LLaVA-1.5 and a TITAN RTX, inference took 0.60 seconds per sample: 4.1× faster than CRG and 25.6× faster than COCO-Tree. Submitted to ICASSP 2027; currently under review.

projects.name: Mote
projects.subtitle: Korean speech recognition, diarization & compression
projects.role: AI development · Dataset curation · Training & evaluation · API integration
projects.summary: I curated Korean speech data and fine-tuned Whisper, then connected speaker-labeled transcripts and meeting summaries to the app.
projects.problem: The service needed to transcribe Korean meetings and domain-specific terminology, distinguish speakers, and run speech models in a deployment environment.
contributions: Collected audio and Korean subtitles from videos, split them into aligned segments, resampled audio to 16 kHz, and filtered out short samples to build training and evaluation datasets. I followed Korean fine-tuning with additional training on software development and economics content.
Applied FP16 and gradient checkpointing, and configured WER evaluation and checkpoint selection in Seq2SeqTrainer. I used x-vectors and spectral clustering to separate speakers’ utterances.

Reduced model size from 3.2 GB to 820 MB through CTranslate2 quantization and configured CPU inference with faster-whisper. I implemented summarization LLM calls and AI APIs, then worked with the backend developer to integrate them into the app.
projects.outcome: Published models and datasets on Hugging Face and integrated speaker-labeled transcription and summarization into the app.

projects.name: WallBaduk
projects.subtitle: Strategy game combining imitation learning, PPO, and search
projects.role: Planning · Design · Model training & game AI · App & multiplayer development · Release
projects.summary: Independently built a 7×7 game, trained a policy–value network with imitation learning and PPO, and shipped its search integration on both app stores.
projects.problem: I needed to combine learned decisions with rule-based search under mobile compute limits and provide distinct difficulty levels.
contributions: Implemented move and wall-placement validation, territory separation, win detection, screens, and customization with Flutter and Firebase. Built real-time multiplayer using room codes, automatic matchmaking, and Firestore synchronization.

Trained a 3,554-parameter residual CNN with policy and value heads on 6,782 actions from 160 completed games. Then ran PPO against search bots, frozen past policies, and the current policy, completing 131,072 learner decisions and 512 updates. Used value bootstrapping for truncated games and auxiliary imitation updates.

Implemented inference in Dart to run the trained model inside the app. The policy guides candidate selection and ordering; the value head contributes 15% to search scores when neural evaluations are available. Terminal outcomes retain the rule-based result.

Built Easy, Normal, Expert, and Sedol tiers. Expert and Sedol share weights but use different candidate breadth and time budgets of 0.5 s and up to 15 s. Added tactical and endgame forced-win proofs and repetition avoidance for Sedol.
projects.outcome: Handled planning, design, development, and release independently, launching the first version on both stores in three weeks. Subsequently shipped the policy–value/search AI update in the production iOS and Android apps.

projects.name: StarGAN-TA
projects.subtitle: Transfer learning for facial expression generation
projects.role: Preprocessing · Model adaptation · Experiments · Co-authored paper
projects.summary: We adapted a pretrained model with five attributes to generate six facial expressions and co-authored a paper at ICROS 2023.
projects.problem: The pretrained StarGAN used five facial attributes, while our task required six expressions. The dimensional mismatch prevented us from loading the weights directly.
contributions: Worked jointly with teammates on face detection, cropping, resizing, model changes, experiments, and paper writing.

Changed the generator input to nine channels for RGB plus six conditions and rebuilt the discriminator’s classification layer. We retained existing weights and initialized the added channel from the mean of the pretrained attribute channels.
In a 2024 follow-up code update, I replaced the generator’s ReLU activations with LeakyReLU and organized the training code and runtime environment.
projects.outcome: Co-authored “StarGAN-TA: Transfer Learning with StarGAN for Improved Facial Expression Generation,” published in the ICROS 2023 conference proceedings.

projects.name: Lenfit
projects.subtitle: Real-time exercise feedback & repetition counting
projects.role: Pose assessment · Repetition counting · Backend integration
projects.summary: I combined joint angles, positions, and movement directions from pose estimates to assess exercise form and count valid repetitions.
projects.problem: Noisy pose estimates and incomplete movements made it difficult to count repetitions using a single angle threshold.
contributions: Converted Google ML Kit joint coordinates into angles and implemented exercise-specific rules combining position, direction, and angle conditions.
Detected squats where the user stood up before reaching sufficient depth, provided corrective feedback, and counted only movements that met the required range of motion.
Worked with the backend developer to integrate these features and coordinate the app’s data transfer and processing flow.
projects.outcome: Implemented real-time exercise feedback and repetition counting for the Lenfit app in the Hanium ICT Mentoring team project.

projects.name: Diff-SVC × DiffWave
projects.subtitle: Singing voice conversion with limited-data augmentation
projects.role: Audio preprocessing & augmentation · Diff-SVC training & experiments
projects.summary: I trained Diff-SVC models for multiple singers and used DiffWave to augment limited voice samples, combining generated and original audio for further training.
projects.problem: Some target singers had too few available voice samples. I needed to supplement the training data to support conversion into those voices.
contributions: Converted audio formats, split recordings into segments, and prepared training data to build Diff-SVC voice conversion models for multiple singers.

Investigated diffusion models for audio generation and used DiffWave to generate augmented audio conditioned on mel spectrograms from the original recordings. I combined the generated and original audio to train Diff-SVC models.
Worked with another AI developer to prepare an original-data-only baseline and a model trained with both original and augmented data, then examined conversion outputs for the same target voice.
projects.outcome: Built voice conversion models for multiple singers and completed training with augmented data. The team integrated the AI models, iOS app, and server into a personalized voice conversion program.

projects.name: RESTED
projects.subtitle: Cognitive rehabilitation quizzes & AI models
projects.role: Quiz design · Model training · Team collaboration & service integration
projects.summary: I built cognitive rehabilitation quizzes using object detection and expression generation, then worked with teammates to complete and demonstrate an AI-assisted self-rehabilitation program.
projects.problem: Model detections and generated images needed to become interactive cognitive rehabilitation activities that users could complete and respond to.
contributions: Fine-tuned an object detection model for everyday objects found in Korean living environments. I built a quiz that selects a target from detected objects and compares it with the object the user presents again.

Preprocessed six emotion classes from AI Hub facial expression data and fine-tuned StarGAN. I built an emotion recognition quiz that generates expressions from a familiar person’s photo and asks users to identify the emotion.
Collaborated with teammates to integrate the cognitive quizzes into the AI-assisted self-rehabilitation service program and jointly demonstrated the completed system.
projects.outcome: Completed and demonstrated the program with the team. RESTED received the Grand Prize in the Intelligent Mechatronics Engineering division at Sejong University’s 16th Creative Design Competition in 2023.

projects.name: WriteNow
projects.subtitle: GPT fine-tuning & document automation
projects.role: Document sample collection · Input/output dataset curation · GPT fine-tuning
projects.summary: To obtain the required JSON outputs, I collected document samples, built input/output training pairs, and fine-tuned GPT through the OpenAI API.
projects.problem: The model at the time did not reliably produce document analysis results in the required JSON structure. It needed to output text-entry and choice fields that the app could use.
contributions: Collected document samples and personally built input/output training pairs: text extracted from Word tables as input, and JSON describing text-entry and choice fields as the target output.

Fine-tuned GPT for document analysis through the OpenAI API using the curated data. I implemented logic that turns the model’s output fields into app questions and maps users’ answers back into document content.
Worked with the backend developer on AI APIs and connected the backend and frontend so users could view generated DOCX documents in the app.
projects.outcome: Handled sample collection, training-data construction, and GPT fine-tuning, and implemented the workflow from template upload through questions and answers to DOCX generation and viewing.

projects.name: Souf
projects.subtitle: Student freelancer platform: founding, development & operations
projects.role: Founder & CEO · Product planning · Development leadership · Operations
projects.summary: I planned a freelancer platform connecting portfolio sharing, client communication, and contracts, and led the team’s development and operations.
projects.problem: Students needed a service that connected their work samples to client inquiries and contracts through a coherent user flow.
contributions: Defined portfolio feed uploads, real-time chat, and contract drafting as core features, then managed the scope and progress of each feature.

Coordinated development around the flow from sharing work to discussing project terms and drafting a contract. With support from Sejong University’s Campus Town program, I registered the business and launched the service.
Operated the launched service and planned an AI portfolio generation feature, progressing through data preparation for its future introduction.
projects.outcome: Launched and operated the student freelancer platform. AI portfolio generation remained a planned follow-up feature supported by data preparation.
